headline: Sep 22 PM · The front door is 404 and the house is fine — that is the day in one line. There was no Sep 22 AM brief, so this PM carries the full day: the Sep 22 cofounder sweep (v15.26) found https://oraya-hq.vercel.app — the URL the founders actually open — returning HTTP 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND (107-byte body) on the root and /index.html across three no-cache fetches, so anyone who opened the board recently saw an error page and would reasonably assume the dashboard was destroyed. It was not: https://oraya-dashboard.vercel.app serves the live board byte-identical to disk and the GitHub repo is fully intact — this brief published to that healthy URL as normal. The evidence best fits an alias/domain detachment, and the fix is one console action (Vercel → Settings → Domains → reattach oraya-hq.vercel.app to the production deployment); stated as inference because the Vercel MCP was auto-declined this sweep, so settings could not be read (w33). Second, the Retell 'Action Required' notice is deliberately DE-ESCALATED, not a fire drill: it names deprecated /list-agents calls, but a repo-wide grep finds zero references and the live call path never enumerates agents — v128/v15 production is unaffected; the only real question is whose curl holds the 'developer' key (w34). Third, the scoreboard: thirteen straight identical digests (Sep 9–21), measured; the fourteenth fires 15:00Z, minutes after this brief, so the one-minute CRM read (w30) and credit check (w32) should land now. Fourth, live US calling Tuesday: b3 (TX reg) + b7 (CA license #) are the first two calls of day 26 at 0/7, and Mary Grossman's hand-dial is eleven days past — eighteenth ask. Accugene has quietly resolved the hopeful way (a Workspace marketing mail still routes to office@accugenediagnostics.com, so the tenant appears alive; one console confirm remains). Watchdog ~271h dark; Meta→CRM sync ~251h silent with no success ever; the $200 Sep 17 receipt ~106h old with zero runs behind it; meeting ingest 33d stale (declined a 6th time); Frankie's QuoteAI Drive request ~129h ungranted; EIN/IRS 86 days silent.

spotlight.title: The founders' dashboard URL is 404 — content is safe, one console click reattaches it (w33)
spotlight.detail: https://oraya-hq.vercel.app — the URL you actually open — returns HTTP 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND (107-byte body) on the root and on /index.html, across three no-cache fetches from the Sep 22 sweep. Anyone who opened the board recently saw an error page and would reasonably think the dashboard was gone. It is not: https://oraya-dashboard.vercel.app serves the full v15 board byte-identical to disk, and the GitHub repo is intact with all history — this very brief published there normally. The evidence best fits an alias/custom-domain detachment, not a failed push or a lost deployment. The fix is one console action: Vercel → the project → Settings → Domains → check whether oraya-hq.vercel.app is still assigned to the production deployment, and if it's missing, re-add and assign it (~15 seconds). Stated as inference because the Vercel MCP was auto-declined this session, so project settings could not be read — a project rename, a deleted target deployment, or an expired assignment would look identical from outside; the console will say which. Use oraya-dashboard.vercel.app in the meantime.
